fusions.name: Stripping the Meadow
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health; every enemy within 2.5 tiles is dealt 6 damage, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Swarming Graze
fusions.desc: Sends a buzzing cloud into the first enemy it meets, dealing 12 damage and leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Endless Cloud
fusions.desc: Sends out a swarm for 20 seconds that bites an enemy within 5 tiles for 3 damage every 1.5 seconds, each bite with a 30% chance to leave the target [Enervated] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gorging Season
fusions.desc: Every kill you make builds a stack on you, up to 3. At 3 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (15% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 15 seconds.
